EICR|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: EICR evidence shows the fixed electrical installation has been inspected within required intervals.

governance.legal_source_summary: Engine frequency_by_age present for EW; Scotland registry entry currently mirrors EW baseline in code — confirm statutory intervals separately if workbook differs.

EPC|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: Valid EPC evidence supports lawful marketing and helps tenants compare running costs.

governance.legal_source_summary: Mapped to EPC; rental vs sale nuances not encoded in this draft.

LEGIONELLA|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: Water system risk reviews reduce legionella exposure for residents and visiting contractors.

identity.description: HMO fire safety evidence / fire risk assessment

HMO_FIRE_RISK|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: HMOs must retain ongoing fire safety management records beyond a single FRA snapshot.

governance.legal_source_summary: HMO-linked fire evidence; NI not listed — do not assume NI HMO parity without workbook/legal confirmation.

action_behaviour.cta_label_override: Upload smoke, heat or CO alarm evidence

SMOKE_HEAT_ALARMS|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: Confirms the property has appropriate alarm systems and evidence that they are installed, maintained, or checked as required.

PAT_TESTING|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: PAT records show portable electrical appliances provided with the let have been formally tested.

RIGHT_TO_RENT|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: England landlords must retain evidence that adult occupiers had a lawful right to rent before move-in.

HOW_TO_RENT|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: Serving the current How to Rent booklet is part of England tenancy paperwork compliance at start.

TENANCY_AGREEMENT|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: The written tenancy records the parties, rent, and terms that govern occupation of the let property.

TENANCY_DEPOSIT_PROTECTION|ENGLAND.why_it_matters_short: England landlords must protect eligible deposits in an authorised scheme and provide prescribed information to the tenant where a tenancy deposit is taken.

TENANCY_DEPOSIT_PROTECTION|WALES.why_it_matters_short: Wales landlords must protect eligible deposits in an authorised scheme and provide prescribed information to the contract-holder where a tenancy deposit is taken.

TENANCY_DEPOSIT_PROTECTION|SCOTLAND.why_it_matters_short: Scotland landlords must protect eligible deposits in an approved scheme and provide prescribed information to the tenant where a tenancy deposit is taken.

TENANCY_DEPOSIT_PROTECTION|NORTHERN_IREL.why_it_matters_short: Northern Ireland landlords must protect eligible deposits in an approved scheme and provide prescribed information to the tenant where a tenancy deposit is taken.

HMO_LICENSING|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: Where licensing applies, keep the licence and conditions of use evidence aligned to the local scheme.

FIRE_RISK_ASSESSMENT|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: The FRA identifies fire hazards and measures; it is distinct from day-to-day alarm servicing records.

OCCUPATION_CONTRACT|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: Renting Homes (Wales) expects written occupation contracts with prescribed terms for regulated lets.

LANDLORD_REGISTRATION|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: Scottish landlords must register and renew with the Scottish Landlord Register to let lawfully.

LANDLORD_REGISTRATION_NI|DEFAULT.why_it_matters_short: NI landlords must register with the Department for Communities where the scheme applies to the let.

action_behaviour.cta_label_override: Upload Rent Smart Wales registration evidence

RENT_SMART_WALES_REGISTRATION|WALES.why_it_matters_short: Rent Smart Wales registration helps demonstrate compliance with Welsh private rented sector registration and licensing obligations.
RENT_SMART_WALES_REGISTRATION|WALES.why_it_matters_long: Landlords operating private rented properties in Wales may need to register with Rent Smart Wales. Additional licensing obligations may also apply where landlords or agents carry out property management activities. Maintaining valid registration and licensing records helps support regulatory compliance and lawful property management operations.

WALES.short: Welsh landlords may need to register with Rent Smart Wales.
WALES.long: Rent Smart Wales registration and licensing schemes help regulate landlord and property management activity within the Welsh private rented sector.

governance.change_reason: Published Wales-specific Rent Smart Wales registration requirement with tenancy-linked applicability and jurisdiction-scoped regulatory guidance.
governance.internal_notes: Requirement intentionally scoped to Welsh landlord registration obligations. Licensing obligations may require separate operational handling.
governance.legal_source_summary: Welsh private rented sector regulation may require landlord registration and, in some cases, licensing through Rent Smart Wales.
